description: List individual recorded activities (runs, rides, swims, strength, etc.) with the activity_id needed for get_activity and get_activity_analysis. Filter by date, type, race, distance, duration, elevation gain, name text or a lat/long box. For totals, averages or trends over weeks/months, use summarize_activities instead: it is far smaller. Default detail='compact' returns key stats only (startTimeLocal as local 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM', distance m, duration/movingDuration s, averageSpeed/maxSpeed m/s, HR, elevation, calories, cadence, power, training effect). Use detail='full' only when a field you need is missing, and with a small limit. Sport-specific extras such as golf scorecards, shot data or dive logs are NOT available.

activity_subtype.description: Subtype key within activity_type, e.g. trail_running, treadmill_running, road_cycling.

activity_type.description: Parent type key, e.g. running, cycling, swimming, strength_training, walking, hiking.

area.description: Only activities that started inside this latitude/longitude box (decimal degrees).

event_type.description: Only activities tagged with this event type, e.g. race.

exclude_children.description: Hide the legs of multisport activities (e.g. a triathlon's swim/bike/run), keeping the parent.

name_contains.description: Text the activity name contains (case-insensitive), e.g. 'parkrun' or 'tempo'.

period.description: Named period resolved in the user's time zone (weeks start Monday). Use instead of start_date/end_date.

sort_by.description: Sort field. Use distance or averageSpeed to find longest or fastest.

name: search_activities
title: Search activities
